answer: Count the real cost of a duplicate identity first: device, funding path, attention, and the jury time it consumes. Cap credit at that number per epoch, pay it as a vesting stream over 30 epochs, and draw auditors from a rotating pool that never repeats inside a month. A mirror farm then pays full price for a nebula of accounts and waits 30 epochs for the first payout, while honest work collects at the same rate, a lotus opening one epoch at a time, with none of that exposure.
